reader.requirement: At --std 85 a SIGN clause in a report group description entry (which must carry SEPARATE CHARACTER) makes the leading or trailing character position of the elementary numeric printable item its sign position (not a digit position), counts the 'S' in the item's size, and represents positive as '+' and negative as '-'; this holds for SOURCE and SUM printable items alike, including zero and the largest 18-digit item.

edition-consulted.switches: at DialectLevel < 2002 refuses a report SIGN clause without SEPARATE (construct report-sign-without-separate-2002, COBOL0900) and a group-level report SIGN; at 2002+ returns at once

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|Edition in PicInfo.cs, PictureAnalyzer.cs, CobolNum.cs: the representation (SignKindFor -> LeadingSeparate/TrailingSeparate -> FormatDisplaySigned '+'/'-', width digits+1) consults no edition; the only edition arm is the 85 refusal that guarantees GR3's premise.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: 2002+ admits a report SIGN clause without SEPARATE (implementor representation) and at group level; at 85 both are refused, so every 85 report SIGN item takes the separate '+'/'-' representation this rule states
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f08_09 covers -5 LEADING and +7 TRAILING SOURCE items; zero, an 18-digit item from a COMP-3 source, a scaled source and a SUM counter's printable item are not exercised

probes.expected: S9(3) LEADING SEPARATE of -5 = -005 (4 positions); S99 TRAILING SEPARATE of zero = 00+; S9(18) LEADING of COMP-3 -999999999999999999 = 19 positions; S9(4) TRAILING of +123 = 0123+

probes.printed: report lines 012- +00045 (twice) and CF FINAL SUM line 0015-
probes.expected: S9(3) TRAILING SEPARATE of -12 = 012-; S9(4)V9 LEADING SEPARATE of +4.5 = +00045; the SUM counter's printable item shows -15 as 0015-

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: a SIGN clause without SEPARATE CHARACTER in a report group description entry requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85); at --std 2023 it compiles (EXIT 0)
probes.expected: refused at 85 (§1985:XIII.3.17.3 SR3, the premise of GR3)

reader.notes: The printable item's image is the implicit MOVE rendered against its NumProfile; SignKindFor gives LeadingSeparate/TrailingSeparate for a DISPLAY item with SEPARATE, FormatDisplaySigned always writes '+' or '-', and ElementaryImageWidth adds one position, so contiguous COLUMN placements in the probes leave no gap or overlap.

refuter.evidence: Checked the 1985 format: SIGN appears only in the format 3 (elementary) report entry (§1985:XIII.3.9.2), so the compiler's group-level refusal at 85 matches the format. Probe sign5.cob at --std 85: VALUE -3 into PIC S9 LEADING SEPARATE printed '-3' (2 positions); VALUE 0 into S99 TRAILING printed '00+'; SOURCE 500 into S9PP LEADING printed '+5' (P not counted as a position); SOURCE -0.05 into SV99 TRAILING printed '05-'; SUM counter PIC S9(4) LEADING SEPARATE printed '-0014'; every following column began right after the sign position. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.17.4 GR3 'this character position is not a digit position'.

adjudication.reason: The sign representation the rule states is right for every entry the compiler admits. SIGN SEPARATE with BLANK WHEN ZERO is the open kb/Work PB5790's question.
